description: This file imports the 'registerRootComponent' function from the 'expo' library and registers the main 'App' component as the root component of the application. It serves as the entry point for the React Native app, establishing the app's root component and setting up the environment for Expo Go or native builds.

methods.name: registerRootComponent
methods.description: Registers the main application component as the root component and sets up the environment for Expo or native build.
